release_gates: The release commit contains both prompt files, both schema definitions, adapters, and tests before any provider write.
Existing preset slugs are retained; no test preset is created.
Full provider version/settings are read back and compared with this manifest after update.
Stage 1 parses and preserves all invoice lines; Vixrex assigns stable row_id values.
Stage 2 returns each row_id exactly once and cannot override invoice quantities or purchase prices.
A 'verified' result must pass official-domain, evidence, and identity-consistency checks; unsupported results stay drafts.
A real invoice uploaded through the Vixrex user interface creates hidden drafts; no AI sale price; publication requires merchant price and approval.
Usage/cost, selected preset version, model, request/job ID, duration, and error code are recorded without raw invoice image or full invoice text in logs.
If the release fails, restore the exact recorded known-good configuration under the same slug; do not delete or blindly retry provider changes.

release_state.reason: Candidate prompts and adapters are in a feature branch. No production preset was changed and no real merchant invoice is available in this sandbox.
